article.headline: Gray has 16, Wagner takes down Chicago State 80-61
article.description: — Travis Gray's 16 points helped Wagner defeat Chicago State 80-61 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Gray has 16, Wagner takes down Chicago State 80-61
article.story: STATEN ISLAND, N.Y. -- — Travis Gray's 16 points helped Wagner defeat Chicago State 80-61 on Saturday. Gray also had 12 rebounds for the Seahawks (13-16, 8-10 Northeast Conference). Nick Jones scored 12 points while shooting 5 of 8 from the floor to go with eight assists. Binael Basil had 11 points and shot 2 of 3 from the field and 7 of 7 from the free-throw line. Marcus Tankersley led the way for the Cougars (7-24, 5-13) with 19 points. Chicago State also got 12 points from CJ Ray. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
